note: Each official website was opened on the retrieval date or (where the site blocks automated requests) matched against Wikidata's official-website property. Founding years are given only where Wikipedia and Wikidata agree; cities only where a source states the headquarters.

records.title: Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC)
records.summary: Manages gurdwaras in Punjab, Himachal Pradesh and Chandigarh, including Sri Darbar Sahib, Amritsar.

records.title: Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee (DSGMC)
records.summary: Manages the gurdwaras of Delhi, along with educational institutions, hospitals, old-age homes and libraries.

records.title: Chief Khalsa Diwan
records.summary: The central organisation of the Singh Sabhas of Punjab, an apolitical body concerned with religious, educational and social work.

records.title: All India Pingalwara Charitable Society
records.summary: Pingalwara, the home for the sick and disabled founded by Bhagat Puran Singh in Amritsar.

records.title: Khalsa Aid
records.summary: An international humanitarian NGO providing aid in disaster areas and civil conflict zones around the world.

records.title: UNITED SIKHS
records.summary: A civil and human rights, humanitarian aid and disaster relief non-governmental organisation affiliated with the United Nations.

records.title: The Sikh Coalition
records.summary: A Sikh American non-profit that defends Sikh civil rights, with offices in New York City, Washington, D.C. and Fremont, California.

records.title: Sikh American Legal Defense and Education Fund (SALDEF)
records.summary: A national non-profit civil rights and educational organisation that protects and promotes the civil rights of Sikh Americans.

records.title: World Sikh Organization of Canada
records.summary: A non-profit organisation that represents and promotes the interests of Sikhs in Canada.

records.title: Sikh Research Institute (SikhRI)
records.summary: A Sikh educational organisation: "Learn, Understand, Apply Sikhi".

records.title: Basics of Sikhi
records.summary: A UK Sikh educational initiative and charity sharing Sikh teachings through videos, Q&As, a blog and a podcast.

records.title: Sikh Missionary Society (U.K.)
records.summary: A society whose aim is the advancement of the Sikh faith in the UK and abroad.
